scripts.dev: VITE_ADMIN_PORT=$(port) VITE_APP_PORT=$(port) BOOTSTRAP_PORT=$(port) UI_PORT=8888 npm run x
scripts.x: hc s clean &&  npm run build:happ && UI_PORT=8888 concurrently "npm start -w ui" "npm run start:happ" "npm run local-services"
scripts.network:electron: hc s clean && npm run build:happ && INTERNAL_IP=$(internal-ip --ipv4) concurrently -k "UI_PORT=1420 npm run -w ui start" "npm run launch:electron"
scripts.test: npm run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive && npm t -w tests
scripts.launch:moss: concurrently "npm start -w ui" "sleep 1 && npm run weave -- --agent-idx 1 --dev-config we_dev/config.ts" "sleep 10 && npm run weave -- --agent-idx 2 --dev-config we_dev/config.ts"
scripts.package: rm -rf ui/dist ui/dist.zip && npm run build:happ && npm run package -w ui && hc web-app pack workdir --recursive && npm run weave-hash
scripts.start:happ: echo "starting with admin $VITE_ADMIN_PORT" && RUST_LOG=warn echo "pass" | hc s -f=$VITE_ADMIN_PORT --piped generate workdir/talking-stickies.happ --run=$VITE_APP_PORT -a talking-stickies network -b "http://127.0.0.1:$BOOTSTRAP_PORT" quic "http://127.0.0.1:$BOOTSTRAP_PORT/relay"
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive
scripts.build:happ:release: npm run build:zomes && npm run optimize:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive
scripts.build:zomes: RUSTFLAGS='--cfg getrandom_backend="custom"' CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.release:webhapp: APP_VER=$(node -p "require('./ui/package.json').version") && git tag v$APP_VER && git push origin v$APP_VER
